div.div: R. Q. 2 تَجَلْبَبَ , (K,) and تَجَلْبَبَتْ, (A, Msb,) He, and she, put on a garment of the kind called جِلْبَاب; or clad himself, and herself, therewith. (A, Msb, K.) And تجلبب بِثَوْبَهَ He covered himself with his garment. (Har p. 162.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
